The source describes GKO as a Keep-Out layer; in the two Altium sample boards it holds the board outline (its bounding box minus the 0.01 in line width equals the drawing dimensions), so it is classed as the outline. Review if a board uses it otherwise.

ASCII NC Drill report: tool, hole size, hole count, plated or not. Used to cross-check the drill file.
